description: Trigger evals for db-context-supabase: it fires when an active task touches a Supabase database and needs the real schema and RLS policies captured, while db-context-postgres, task-init, decision-interview, rls-auth-boundary-auditor and migration-safety-steward handle other Postgres hosts, a missing task folder, schema decisions, policy audits, and DDL safety.
